# rixl_domain_auto_join (Resource)

Configures whether users with matching corporate email domains can automatically join a Rixl organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_domain_auto_join" "corp" {
  org_id  = var.rixl_org_id
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `org_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `present` (Boolean)
